CHIEF REVIEW — AMEND before approval of 834f280.

The center is sound: preserve exact P and F, keep Viterbi separate, retain hierarchy and fidelity modes, distinguish every external state and Unranked, refuse omission without a frozen eligible universe, and call mass model-relative rather than calibrated. Four acceptance gaps remain.

1. Lines 237-238 make a false source claim. At e584ad6, hsmm.scala:448 checks a Viterbi state only with check(unit,state), which proves nomination and mode admission; it does not require row.mass.contains(state). Likewise hsmm.scala:407-410 checks F endpoints only for nomination and gate admission, while marginalsMatch at :470-477 treats an absent row key as numeric zero. Thus HsmmResult.validated can admit a nominated/admitted Viterbi state outside P and an explicit zero-flow key whose endpoint is outside the adjacent P state set. The lowering must independently refuse both shapes, or HsmmResult must first be hardened under a separate code bead. Add two named mutations: substitute an admitted-but-row-absent Viterbi state; inject a zero F key with a row-absent endpoint. Key presence is the defect.

2. Revisit at lines 220-221 is not yet a useful derived estimand. GraphHsmm gives positive mass to every finite admissible state, so any positive-mass rule can label tiny numerical support as a revisit. Freeze the row-support and incoming-flow rule in view identity, require present zero never qualifies, preserve exact mass, and either use a predeclared threshold or label the quantity without the categorical revisit claim. Add a threshold/removal mutation.

3. The packet requires exact recall text in a self-contained artifact, while codec/README.md:31 states RecallGraph still carries a plain StorySource. Constitution IX and AGENTS.md:345-350 make consent, REB, and licence separate from pseudonymization. Make preview local-sensitive by default; no shareable or publication-ready disposition may follow from semantic validity or pseudonymization. Require a separately established disclosure/admission outcome, synthetic/admitted fixture text, and a mutation that flips local-only to shareable without authority. A redacted report, if later authorized, remains a separately identified report projection and may not rewrite the semantic packet.

4. Record one more current-source gap: hsmm.scala:269 rejects NaN logLikelihood but admits positive or negative infinity. Since the packet carries logLikelihood, publication-grade lowering must refuse a non-finite value or preserve P/F with an explicit audit refusal; it must never render infinity as an ordinary measured statistic. Add the deletion/substitution mutation.

Authorized successor scope remains exactly docs/design/recall-alignment-visualization-court.md, no Scala/API/film/corpus/calibration change. Gate: git diff --check plus revised source-line checklist and all new mutation descriptions. Create a distinct successor SHA over e584ad6 and proposer-supersede the canonical candidate if the reducer permits; do not mutate the duplicate same-SHA row or the stranded ancestor.
